construction.definition: RSS includes interpreter, imported libraries and mapped resident pages; not disk size

evaluation.definition: RSS includes interpreter, imported libraries and mapped resident pages; not disk size

config.identity: 基于 AH53 名义版图的合成工艺形貌；非实测重建

scenes.status: 验证假设；现有 AH53_DEMO GDS 仅 8×2 μm，不能据其确定完整 Mark 尺寸

synthetic.field_definition: Independent random-phase finite Fourier sums; weights normalized so theoretical infinite-domain RMS equals configured RMS. Fixed spectral wavelengths >=160nm; short and long bands around 0.3um and2um. Finite-window actual RMS remeasured.

config.end_faces: Z ends close the computational window and are excluded from free-surface errors

model_metadata.reference_definition: Independent analytic piecewise contour; no spline/triangle/voxel dependency
model_metadata.classification_rule: closed source stripe intervals at voxel centers; substrate y<0; outside domain air
model_metadata.query: actual saved label array only; boundaries are cell-face transitions; no smoothing

section_distance.region_assignment: candidate samples assigned by nearest reference segment

profiles.demeaning: subtract each line's mean at each fixed physical Y; no detrending

material.sampling: global random XY on 37 independent fixed Z planes; fixed normal band around complete free XY contours; deterministic seed

definition.reference_and_parametric: Cross-section polygon areas at independent 4-point Gauss-Legendre stations inside <=40 nm Z panels; no station coincides with an input Z knot.
definition.triangle: Exact divergence-theorem volume of the saved oriented triangle mesh.
definition.voxel: Exact persisted material-1 label count times isotropic cell volume.
definition.scope: Auxiliary volume accuracy; no substitution for local boundary errors.

volume_readback_audit: Independent quadrature update from unchanged saved models; timing and memory in volume_quadrature_audit.json
